title: 'One Battle After Another' takes best picture. Here's the full list of Oscar winners
summary: Michael B. Jordan and Jessie Buckley won best actor and best actress. Paul Thomas Anderson received best director. Cassandra Kulukundis won the Academy's first ever casting award.
contentText:
One Battle After Another accept the Academy Award for best picture at the 2026 Oscars.'/> Michael B. Jordan and Jessie Buckley won best actor and best actress . Paul Thomas Anderson received best director . Cassandra Kulukundis won the Academy's first ever casting award.

(Image credit: Kevin Winter)
